rule: FINAL_APP_READY requires the approved cinematic and semantic presentation systems to be active on the modular six-surface app. Static surface parity alone is insufficient.

reference.architecture: presentation-only; no liturgical, data, or navigation ownership

bootCinematic.note: Cold-load boot cinematic still exists in the monolith, but remains owned by the legacy embedded presentation layer.

modularRouteTransitions.note: The modular six-surface shell now calls the existing v43.12 cinematic owner instead of bypassing it.

modularAsyncLoader.note: Slow modular surface navigation reuses the v43.12 loader card after a short delay.

modularSurfaceEntry.note: Home, Mass, PRAY, Learn, Calendar and Settings can reuse the approved v43.12 surface-entry motion.

artLoading.note: The old shimmer/blur-in art loader still targets historical art selectors; modular surface coverage requires audit.

verticalSemanticRails.note: PRAY restores geometry-neutral semantic icon rails without duplicating horizontal stage navigation. Angelus exposes resolved Stand/Kneel plus devotional context. Stations exposes sourced attention/context cues without inventing a universal posture. Adoration, Benediction and Confession expose canonical contextual identity. The external canonical Rosary player now has its own live mystery/context rail.

heroPresenceAndEntryChoreography.note: Static hero hierarchy is certified per surface; prototype-level hero animation, atmospheric entry and art choreography are not.

reducedMotion.note: System and app reduced-motion preferences suppress non-essential FX.

rosaryLiveFx.note: The preserved canonical Rosary player receives a geometry-neutral right context rail from AO_ROSARY_V381 state and reuses AO_CINEMATIC_V4312 only when a new mystery is entered. No universal Rosary posture is invented, bead navigation is untouched, reduced motion suppresses the cinematic, and PR #183 passed Visual acceptance, App convergence and R17 convergence.

stationsLiveFx.note: Stations now uses the canonical look/attention asset to cue facing the current Station, keeps the canonical Stations identity rail with the current XIV-step context, and reuses AO_CINEMATIC_V4312 on actual station changes. The recovery deliberately does not invent a universal kneel/stand track: the blueprint classifies movement and posture as contextual/traditional, and at-home use must not simulate a procession. CI validation is required before certification.

nextRecoveryTargets: phone-certify Stations semantic cue rail and station-change cinematic on 390x844 production geometry
recover approved hero/art entry choreography across modular Home/PRAY/Learn/Calendar surfaces
extend cinematic art-loading treatment to current modular art owners and prove real loading states
extract v43.12 cinematic owner from monolithic index.html only after full presentation-FX behavior parity is locked
